purpose: Test whether the frozen 88-site Paper 2 support roster has repeat optical-image coverage sufficient to estimate longitudinal change in accessible ice-free breeding opportunity, without inspecting demographic magnitudes or trends.

season_filter.definition: Austral optical season. December belongs to the following austral-season label, as do July-November; January-June retain their calendar-year label.
season_filter.rationale: Restrict availability to spring-summer optical observations rather than counting dark-season acquisitions.

site_gate.cloud_cover_role: Recorded descriptively only at this stage; no cloud threshold is used for inclusion. Pixel-level cloud, snow, shadow and valid-area QA is a later frozen gate.

program_feasibility_gate.interpretation: These thresholds are a feasibility gate for a multi-site longitudinal test, not an ecological significance threshold.

surface_reflectance_caveat.rule: Catalog availability does not imply scientifically valid surface reflectance at Antarctic sites.
surface_reflectance_caveat.required_next_gate: Inspect solar geometry and pixel-level QA before any habitat-change metric is computed.
surface_reflectance_caveat.high_latitude_flag: Record whether abs(latitude) > 65 degrees for every site.
surface_reflectance_caveat.reason: USGS documents larger surface-reflectance uncertainty at high latitude, non-production above 76 degrees solar zenith, and additional issues over snow, low sun angle and small coastal land targets.

stop_rule: Do not relax date windows, minimum acquisition counts, minimum season counts, or feasibility thresholds after demographic outcomes are joined. If catalog support fails, either stop the dynamic-habitat Paper 2 lane or define a new processing-level/source audit before opening outcomes.
